description: Code-behind for ShowAns.aspx page; handles displaying and submitting answers for a student in an online exam system, including database interactions for retrieving answers and updating marks.

classes.name: ShowAns
classes.description: Code-behind class for ShowAns.aspx, managing answer display and submission.

methods.name: Page_Load
methods.description: Handles page load event; retrieves student answers from database and populates UI controls.

methods.name: submitB_Click
methods.description: Calculates total marks, updates database with marks, removes student from queue, and redirects.

methods.name: logoutB_Click
methods.description: Logs out user and redirects to LoginPage.aspx.
